breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the mass/volume conservation violation at all. Instead of correcting the inconsistent flow rates (0.01 vs 0.02 m³/s) and establishing that Q_in = Q_out for steady incompressible flow in a constant-area pipe, it asks an irrelevant question about fluid type. The ground truth requires applying mass conservation to show Q is constant, but the generated output completely ignores this fundamental issue.
